glosses: Of, or relating to a Christian religious movement that emphasizes the Holy Spirit.
A member of a Pentecostal church.

examples.text: The Pentecostals had drowned them with their discotheque music, frenzied dancing and ecstatic prayer.

glosses: An offering formerly made to the parish priest, or to the mother church, at Pentecost.
